$comment: One concept, one word. Read by scripts/check-glossary.mjs (tests/i18n-glossary.test.ts, pre-commit). Per term: the canonical ja and en word, why, the variants to avoid per language (regexes; '*' for every language), optional 'keys' (a regex: the rule reads only those catalog keys) and 'except' (catalog keys the rule skips, each with a reason). See .claude/rules/i18n.md.

terms.why: Putting an engine, an extension or a model on this PC is Install, as on the Models screen and in ComfyUI-Manager; 入れる stays for typing text and for putting a job in the queue

ja: (拡張機能|拡張|パック|モデル|エンジン|ライブラリ|ComfyUI)(を|が|は|も)?(まだ)?(入れ|入っ)

terms.why: A ComfyUI custom node pack is called an extension on every screen (the Extensions tab); 'custom node' may explain it, 'pack' alone is not used for it
Stopping a job or an install before it ends is Cancel, as in the queue (InvokeAI and ComfyUI say Cancel)
A button that makes a model or an extension ready to use is Install, as on the Models screen; Download stays for the transfer itself and for saving to the PC
Running a failed job or download again is Retry (the queue's button); やり直す is Redo
The status of a job or an install that did not finish is Failed, as in the queue
The status of a job or an install that finished is Completed, as in the queue
Who made a model, an extension or a workflow is the author, as ComfyUI-Manager and Hugging Face say
The usual spelling, as ComfyUI and InvokeAI write it
The model's own spelling; ComfyUI_IPAdapter_plus is the name of an extension and stays as it is
The English text uses American spelling, as InvokeAI and ComfyUI do
